hash.description: Hash of the value, allows user to perform point queries (e.g. where field = H(value))

title:
Type to represent encrypted value generated by {@link SymmetricCipher}. This type contains encrypted data and
metadata which enables platform to decrypt and point queries. @see SymmetricCipher first fetches encrypted
data encryption key(dek) dekId persisted in {@link SymmetricCipher} and decrypts in memory using active
key encryption key ({@link SymmetricCipherConfig}). It then decrypts the encrypted value using data encryption key
and returns plain data.
name: EncryptedValue
